text:
michael: quick follow-up from today's all-hands sec panel. single thread for SOC2/ISO evidence, VPC choices, audit-log export paths, and KMS/BYOK rotation.

elena: short answers up top: yes we provide SOC2/ISO evidence bundles; VPC: prefer Interface Endpoints/PrivateLink; audit logs can be exported (hosted -> managed bucket, private -> customer bucket via export role); BYOK supported with rotation workflow.

priya: to request evidence or longer retention use the compliance form: https://bit.ly/rwd-compliance. include org, project, desired retention, and evidence_owner. allow 72-72h lead time for manual bundles.

dan: export details: hosted default -> s3://redwood-logs/audit/<region>/; private -> s3://<customer-bucket>/redwood/audit/<cluster>/YYYY/MM/DD/. default retention 90 days; set retention_days in request to get 180 or 365.

michael: perms question 12 do teams need to pre-create buckets?

elena: for Private we ask you to provide bucket ARN and we create a cross-account role. for hosted we can arrange signed snapshots to your bucket.

priya: KMS/BYOK: support CMKs + imported key material. recommend rotation every 90 days for high-sensitivity customers; for imported keys include rotation schedule in onboarding. HSM options available via security onboarding.

security-bot: Ticket COMP-2144 created to track outstanding evidence and retention requests from this thread.

d an: action items: i'll post a one-pager + IAM policy example + small `aws iam` snippet in #eng-docs by EOD today. office hours scheduled: Tue 11am PT (security + eng-platform). link: https://meet.redwood.ai/sec-office.

michael: thanks everyone. i'll consolidate product questions and post before office hours.
